notes.title: Demo Update V3
notes.content:
We have been getting amazing feedback from our players! We have implemented a bunch of tweaks and fixes based on YOUR input! Keep it up!

[list]
[*] Reworked the spacing on the Essence and Fragment icons as they overlapped at high capacities.
[*] Adjusted sound mixing volumes.
[*] Added drop shadow to the F to continue.
[*] Added a dialogue when interacting with restorable using the wrong character. 
[*] Fixed Bo getting stuck after waking a Bo near the boss.
[*] Fixed East pillar not lowering fully.
[*] Reduced the amount of essence Elder Po generates based on fellow Bo's
[*] Fixed Bo not playing the correct animation when resuming a shard carry.
[*] Fixed a Game breaking issue, at the west resource puzzle, if F1ll jumps off the ledge whilst Bo is in the far cave. F1LL can now no longer jump down.
[*] Added visual feedback for bar on singing minigame
[*] Added additional cinematics to explain resources and Well mechanic
[*] Added visual cues for f1ll to show where he is in relation to the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue with cutscenes which caused the screen to flicker when spamming F.
[*] Adjusted some dialogue with interactions between the characters and Elder Po.
[*] Stopped the character animations from freezing so quickly during the cutscene with Elder Po. 
[*] Fixed the issue which caused the game to launch in SteamVR.
[*] Solved a game breaking bug with the East puzzle. 
[*] Increased the size and altered the position of the Bo's on the UI although may need more tweaking. 
[*] ome improvements to the singing minigame, notes now appear on designated tracks as well as having button indicators on the track itself in the hit location.
[*] Added arrow notches to the W, A, S, D keys for better readability.
[/list]
